description.value: Just Pizza opened in August 2024 on Kingsway in East Vancouver, founded by chef Steven Che — who trained at Michelin-starred restaurants and a sourdough bakery in Oslo — and product marketer Jan Natividad. The menu pairs elevated classics with globally inspired combinations, all on a freshly made 12-inch sourdough crust. It positions itself as a neighbourhood go-to for quality takeout pizza on one of East Vancouver's main arterials.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 42m; rack at 61m; rack (covered) at 84m; rack at 90m. Total: 6 spaces.
